The lock defends against the naive attacker, whose fine-tuning drives capability below pretrained on all three models. It does not defend against an informed attacker, who freezes or fuses the compensation matrix to restore near-unlocked performance. A compensation-free lock we build from the network's own rescaling symmetries again defeats the naive attacker, but canonical rebalancing removes it without knowledge of the lock. The barrier is one of knowledge, not compute.

summary.takeaway: 检验“权重锁定”作为开放权重生物基础模型防微调 safeguard 的有效性，发现其仅能抵御缺乏知识的朴素攻击者，无法抵御知情攻击者。
summary.methods: 对两个 Evo 家族模型和蛋白模型 ESM3-open 施加基于谱变形的权重锁定，并设计知识水平递增的攻击者（包括冻结或融合补偿矩阵，以及利用网络重缩放对称性构建的免补偿锁）。
summary.relevance: 涉及预训练基础模型的开放权重发布与微调风险，属于基础模型安全与训练后微调防护议题。
summary.caveat: 结论限于所测试的 Evo 家族与 ESM3-open 及所设攻击方式；作者指出障碍在于知识而非算力，但摘要未给出跨模型族或真实攻击场景的泛化证据。

papers.title: DELTA: Training-free and label-free correction of pathology foundation model embeddings through paired counterfactual stain-appearance interventions
papers.abstract: Staining and scanning variation impairs pathology foundation model (FM) generalization. We propose DELTA, a training-free, label-free method for post-hoc correction of FM embeddings. DELTA estimates recurrent directions from paired embedding differences between original patches and counterfactual stain-appearance variants preserving spatial structure, then attenuates aligned components through a fixed projection. Estimation from 4% of eligible patches per source dataset required no separately acquired matched images. Operators directly correct stored embeddings. On PathoROB, DELTA improved patch-level representation robustness over raw embeddings in all 20 FMs. Mean classification gains over established correction methods persisted after patch aggregation. DELTA provided additional gains after stain normalization. Whole-slide analyses showed improved in-distribution survival discrimination in TCGA-BRCA and normative cancer screening in a clinical cohort. Operators from TCGA-BRCA reduced embedding variation in the PLISM dataset across 13 staining conditions and 7 scanners without refitting. With projection rank and center matched, DELTA outperformed projections from mismatched pairs in retrieval and tissue-category concordance. Corrected embeddings retained information for spatial gene-expression prediction in the STP-BENCH datasets, with gains for tumor microenvironment markers in selected cohorts.

summary.takeaway: 提出无需训练和标签的 DELTA 方法，通过配对的反事实染色外观干预估计并投影去除病理基础模型嵌入中的染色扫描变异方向。
summary.methods: 对原始 patch 与其保持空间结构的反事实染色变体计算嵌入差，估计重复方向并用固定投影衰减对齐分量；每个源数据集仅用 4% 合格 patch 估计；在 PathoROB、TCGA-BRCA、PLISM 及 STP-BENCH 等数据上评估多种病理 FM。
summary.relevance: 面向预训练病理基础模型嵌入的鲁棒性与后处理校正，属于基础模型表征泛化问题。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告的是嵌入鲁棒性与下游任务指标的改进，未说明对原始诊断性能的潜在信息损失程度；投影秩与中心需匹配，跨数据集迁移虽无需重拟合但依赖源数据估计质量。

papers.title: A Hierarchical KAN-Augmented Graph Convolutional Model for Inferring Cell-Type-Specific Gene Regulations in Single-Cell Omics.
papers.abstract: Accurate inference of gene regulatory networks (GRNs) from single-cell RNA-seq data remains challenging due to the complexity of transcription factor (TF)-target interactions and the difficulty in capturing both local and global regulatory dependencies. Here, we present GeneKAN, a novel deep learning framework that integrates multiscale graph convolution with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) for robust GRN inference. GeneKAN employs a kernel-based graph convolution module to hierarchically encode gene representations, while KANs model high-order, interpretable TF-target relationships through learnable spline activations. Benchmarking against eleven existing models, and seven scRNA-seq datasets from BEELINE, including diverse cell types, species, and ground-truth networks (ChIP-seq, STRING, LOF/GOF), demonstrates that our proposed GeneKAN achieves state-of-the-art performance in both AUROC and AUPRC. Ablation studies of the proposed model confirm the necessity of each component. Biological validation on human hepatocyte and lung cancer datasets reveals that GeneKAN not only recovers known regulatory interactions with high precision but also identifies functionally relevant hub genes and oncogenic pathways. GeneKAN thus offers a powerful, interpretable, and scalable solution for GRN reconstruction under real-world conditions of data sparsity and noise, with significant potential for advancing systems biology and precision medicine.

summary.takeaway: 提出 GeneKAN，将多尺度图卷积与 Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks 结合，用于单细胞 RNA-seq 的基因调控网络推断。
summary.methods: 核化图卷积分层编码基因表示，KAN 以可学习样条激活建模高阶可解释的 TF-靶标关系；在 BEELINE 的七个 scRNA-seq 数据集上与十一个模型比较，并做人肝细胞与肺癌数据的生物学验证及消融实验。
summary.relevance: 直接对应 GRN/Regulon 推断主题，且涉及深度学习模型架构在调控网络重建中的应用。
summary.caveat: 性能依赖基准真值网络类型（ChIP-seq、STRING、LOF/GOF）与数据集选择；摘要未量化噪声与稀疏条件下的稳定性边界，生物学验证为案例式而非系统评估。

papers.title: DermKG: A Concept-Centric Knowledge Graph for Interpretable Skin Disease Diagnosis from Dermatological Morphology
papers.abstract: Dermatologists describe lesions with a standardized morphological lexicon, which makes concept-based models attractive for interpretable skin disease diagnosis. How much diagnostic information these concepts actually carry, however, is rarely quantified. We present DermKG, a concept-centric knowledge graph built on the expert-annotated SkinCon subset of Fitzpatrick17k (3,230 images, 48 concepts, 113 diseases). DermKG has 3,452 nodes of 8 types and 19,365 edges of 11 relation types, and encodes disease concept profiles, concept co-occurrence, a three-level diagnostic hierarchy, and 20 clinical morphology rules, all of which are supported by the training data (15 strong, 5 moderate). An information-ceiling analysis shows that the 3,230 lesions collapse onto only 813 distinct concept vectors, bounding concept-only top-1 accuracy at 38.9\% for diseases and 77.6\% for the nine categories. Within this bound, DermKG-Net, a graph neural network that scores lesions against disease prototypes and aggregates them along the hierarchy, raises category-level balanced accuracy from 0.257 to 0.411 over the strongest of 11 baselines (paired bootstrap difference $+0.150$, 95\% CI $[0.073, 0.231]$) and more than doubles minority-category recall. Ablations show that most of this gain comes from the hierarchical prototype objective, with a smaller contribution from graph structure. DermKG further yields rule-based reasoning chains and concept-level explanations for individual predictions.

summary.takeaway: 构建概念中心的知识图谱 DermKG，并量化皮肤病变形态学概念本身所携带的诊断信息上限，进而提出沿诊断层级聚合的 DermKG-Net。
summary.methods: 基于 Fitzpatrick17k 的 SkinCon 专家标注子集（3,230 张图像、48 个概念、113 种疾病）构建含 8 类节点、11 类关系的图谱，编码疾病概念画像、概念共现、三级诊断层级与 20 条形态学规则；做信息上限分析与图神经网络原型评分，并与 11 个基线比较。
summary.relevance: 属于知识图谱用于可解释诊断的方向，同时涉及概念表示信息量与图结构贡献的辨析。
summary.caveat: 概念仅能区分 813 种概念向量，概念-only 疾病 top-1 上限为 38.9%，说明任务本身受限；增益主要来自层级原型目标而非图结构，且数据来自单一标注子集。

papers.title: AutoOntologyBench: A Task-Grounded Benchmark for Agentic Knowledge Engineering
papers.abstract: Foundation-model agents are increasingly extending beyond software engineering (SWE) into autonomous scientific research, where acquiring and integrating domain knowledge remains a critical challenge. Recent industrial advances have increasingly adopted knowledge graphs and ontology-based semantic layers to organize heterogeneous knowledge into reusable representations. We ask: Can autonomous agents construct ontologies that help them solve real tasks, and do they offer measurable benefits over alternative knowledge representations? Existing benchmarks evaluate ontology correctness or agent task success in isolation, leaving the value of autonomously acquired knowledge unresolved. We therefore introduce AutoOntologyBench, a task-grounded benchmark comprising 19,947 audited tasks grounded in 18 real-world knowledge sources across 7 domains, with source-native verification. Spanning Application, Repair, Organization, and Construction, AutoOntologyBench compares nine frontier-model agents under matched knowledge representations. Layered on retrieval, agent-built ontologies add 6.1 points of task success, yet trail an expert-derived reference by 13.0, identifying autonomous knowledge acquisition as the bottleneck to scalable scientific research. Code and resources are available at https://github.com/VinyehShaw/AutoOntologyBench.

summary.takeaway: 提出任务落地的 AutoOntologyBench，用于检验自主智能体构建的本体能否帮助完成真实任务，以及是否优于其他知识表示。
summary.methods: 构建含 19,947 个经审计任务、覆盖 7 个领域 18 个真实知识源的基准，涵盖应用、修复、组织与构建四类任务，在匹配知识表示下比较九个前沿模型智能体，并以源生验证评估。
summary.relevance: 关联知识图谱与本体在智能体知识工程中的作用，也涉及基础模型智能体的自主知识获取能力。
summary.caveat: 摘要给出的比较结论为智能体构建本体在检索之上带来任务成功提升但仍落后专家参考，差距被归因于自主知识获取瓶颈；具体领域与模型覆盖有限，结论不宜外推到所有科学任务。

papers.title: Observed, Curated, Reused: Observation Bias in Clinical AI Evaluation
papers.abstract: Clinical AI evaluations are vulnerable to observation bias embedded in routine medical documentation, which captures only what clinicians notice, test, and record rather than a complete clinical picture. As this evidence travels into publications and reference knowledge graphs, crucial distinctions disappear: unexamined symptoms blur with confirmed negatives, and chronological disease progression is lost. Surviving evidence can also enter both the benchmark query and the reference knowledge base, creating a self-referential loop where a patient is evaluated against clues derived from their own published case report. To quantify this bias, we tracked 6,503 clinical cases across six historical Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO) releases (October 2021-June 2026) to identify when HPO first cited the publications describing them. This yielded a confirmatory cohort with an observable "source ingestion" event, where HPO cited a case's source publication as target-disease evidence. Diagnostic rankers depended heavily on these source publications: for our primary semantic ranker (Resnik), publication-weighted mean reciprocal rank rose from 0.26 before paper ingestion to 0.84 upon inclusion in HPO, but collapsed to 0.05 when source-linked assertions were counterfactually removed. Two additional rankers (IC-cosine and LIRICAL) reproduced this trajectory, and control experiments confirmed the diagnostic jump was driven by the patient's publication rather than background HPO growth. Clinical AI systems may therefore score well because their knowledge base contains evidence linked to the test case's source publication, rather than through generalization. Modern knowledge is not the problem; evaluation evidence must match the claim. Trustworthy benchmarks must separate patients, source-linked evidence, and time: historical tests should use only knowledge available at the intended decision time.

summary.takeaway: 揭示临床 AI 评估中的观察偏倚：知识图谱可能引用测试病例自身的来源文献，使排序器看似表现优异实则存在自指循环。
summary.methods: 追踪 6,503 个临床病例在六个历史 HPO 版本中的引用摄入事件，构建可观测“来源摄入”的确认性队列，比较 Resnik、IC-cosine 与 LIRICAL 排序器在论文摄入前后的表现并做反事实移除与对照实验。
summary.relevance: 直接涉及知识图谱作为评测知识库的效度问题，对知识图谱驱动的临床 AI 评估设计有警示意义。
summary.caveat: 分析聚焦 HPO 与所追踪病例及三个排序器，观察偏倚程度可能随知识库构建流程不同而变化；摘要未评估其他临床知识库或真实前瞻场景。

papers.title: A single-cell transcriptomic atlas of T cells across murine lymphoid, mucosal, and gland tissues
papers.abstract: T cells play essential roles in immune surveillance, host defense, and tissue homeostasis, with their cellular composition and transcriptional states varying across tissues. In this study, we constructed an integrated single-cell transcriptional atlas of 124,186 T cells from seven organs of healthy mice. We identified shared T cell states with distinct tissue associated distributions and transcriptional features. Further analyses revealed transcriptional changes associated with thymocyte maturation, diverse innate-like and memory-like T cell populations in bone marrow, and distinct regional distributions of CD8-like T cell states in the intestine. The submandibular gland contained diverse naive, helper-associated, and effector-associated T cell states. pySCENIC analysis further revealed tissue associated variation in inferred transcription factor regulon activity within shared T cell populations. Together, these findings provide a single cell reference for understanding T cell heterogeneity across lymphoid and non-lymphoid tissues under physiological conditions.

summary.takeaway: 构建覆盖小鼠七个器官、124,186 个 T 细胞的整合单细胞转录图谱，刻画共享 T 细胞状态的组织相关分布与转录特征。
summary.methods: 整合多组织 scRNA-seq 数据，鉴定共享 T 细胞状态并分析其组织分布；结合胸腺细胞成熟、骨髓先天样与记忆样群体、肠道 CD8 样状态区域分布及下颌下腺状态分析，并用 pySCENIC 推断 TF regulon 活性的组织差异。
summary.relevance: 与 GRN/Regulon 主题相关，提供跨组织 T 细胞 regulon 活性变异的资源性参考。
summary.caveat: 为健康小鼠生理条件下的描述性图谱，regulon 活性为计算方法推断而非实验验证；摘要未报告跨个体或批次效应的量化评估。

papers.title: A cytoskeletal toggle switch controls amnion architecture and fate
papers.abstract: Binary cellular decisions are generally attributed to gene regulatory networks, with cytoskeletal-driven shape changes often treated as an output. Yet, whether the cytoskeleton can itself implement switch-like logic to drive abrupt morphological transitions remains unknown. In the primate amniotic sac, the extraembryonic amnion derives directly from the columnar epiblast and abruptly flattens into a squamous epithelium to form a highly asymmetric cavity. Here, we identify a cytoskeletal switch driving this developmental bifurcation in human gastrula models. Mutual inhibition between actomyosin and keratin networks generates two mechanical attractors: amnion cells flip into a keratin-rich, squamous shape, while the epiblast remains myosin-rich and columnar. Ectopic activation of YAP1-TEAD signaling triggers the myosin-keratin switch without inducing amnion specification, establishing that the switch is not simply a consequence of fate changes. Conversely, preventing the switch disrupts amnion specification, showing that this shape bifurcation gates lineage commitment. Single-cell transcriptomics across cytoskeletal perturbations revealed a transcriptional signature for the toggle switch, which is recapitulated in vivo in the human and marmoset amnion. Together, our findings show that the cytoskeleton acts not only as an effector of tissue shape but as a decision-making module, implementing the same toggle switch logic as gene regulatory networks to drive morphological bifurcations.

summary.takeaway: 研究提出细胞骨架本身可像基因调控网络一样实现双稳态开关逻辑：actomyosin与keratin网络的相互抑制产生两个力学吸引子，驱动羊膜细胞由柱状 abruptly 转为鳞状，并且该形态分叉反过来控制谱系决定。
summary.methods: 利用人类原肠胚模型，结合细胞骨架扰动、YAP1-TEAD信号激活以及单细胞转录组测序，并在人类与marmoset羊膜中验证转录特征。
summary.relevance: 与GRN/Regulon主题相关，因为它把经典上归于基因调控网络的双稳态开关逻辑扩展到细胞骨架网络，并显示形态分叉可反过来影响谱系承诺，提示调控逻辑不止于转录因子网络。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体分子互作细节、扰动类型与样本量；YAP1-TEAD激活是否足以独立于羊膜特化程序仍未完全界定，且结论主要基于体外原肠胚模型并在两种灵长类中验证，其他物种与体内功能必要性尚需进一步研究。
